name: Design-studio eight-gate loop with a mode router and a revert gate
description: Run the whole design pipeline over a RUNNING app - prime, direct, transpose, critique, iterate, implement, drive, verify - with two properties that make it more than a checklist. First, a mode ROUTER: every gate carries an entry condition, so a caller can enter at the audit gate without the earlier gates having run, and no gate may silently depend on a skipped predecessor. Second, a REVERT gate: the implement gate is the only stage permitted to write app source, and a change that fails its post-check is reverted automatically by a repair loop whose verify stage is independent of the agent that made the change.

app_target.description: The LOCAL running app under design. Never a production instance.

mode.description: Router selector. 'loop' runs every gate; any other value enters at that gate.

entry_gate.description: Numeric form of the router. Each gate's `when` compares against this, so gate skipping is declarative and auditable rather than implicit in a skill's prose.

design_intent.description: What the pass is meant to achieve, so G7 can verify the INTENDED delta rather than taste.

allow_source_writes.description: The implement gate refuses to write app source unless this is explicitly true.

target_composite.description: The DESIGN-EVAL composite the iterate loop is aiming at. A param, not a metric: the loop measures composite_score and compares it against this declared target, so the exit condition is authored rather than inferred.

primer.description: G0: attaches to the running app and records the pre-change baseline every later gate is measured against.

director.description: G1: fixes the design direction - style, palette, typography - before anything is changed.

implementer.description: G5: the ONLY role with app-source write permission, and only when allow_source_writes is true.

driver.description: G6: drives the app to exercise the change without editing source.

verifier.description: G7: measures the delta against the recorded intent and the G0 baseline. Holds the revert veto and never edits source.

reverter.description: Undoes a change the verifier rejected. Separate from the implementer so the author does not judge its own revert.

routes.reason: the revert veto must not be held by the vendor that authored the change

stages.title: G0 PRIME - attach to the app and capture the baseline

work_unit.title: Attach to the running app and record the pre-change baseline
work_unit.question_or_target: Attach to app_target, capture a screenshot and accessibility snapshot per surface, and record them as THE baseline every later gate compares against - so a later 'improvement' is measured, not asserted.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus; deciding what constitutes a surface is judgement

work_unit.evidence_requirement: one screenshot plus one accessibility snapshot per enumerated surface, each with the surface identifier and capture parameters
tests_required: an unreachable app HALTS at G0 rather than auditing nothing and reporting clean
the baseline names every surface it captured, so a later gate cannot compare against a surface that was never recorded
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the verifier, who must be able to recompute the delta from this baseline alone
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7701 emitted only when the app is attached and a per-surface baseline exists on disk; otherwise FAILED:UX-7701 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: relaunch the app once, then report app-unreachable rather than continuing blind
work_unit.mechanism: attach-and-baseline capture that makes every later delta measurable

stages.title: An unreachable app halts the loop - it does not audit nothing
G1 DIRECT - fix the design direction before anything changes

work_unit.title: Record the design direction the pass will be judged against
work_unit.question_or_target: Commit to a style, palette and type direction with a rationale, so G7 can verify against the INTENDED design rather than against the verifier's taste.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: direction is a design judgement and the highest-leverage decision in the pass

work_unit.evidence_requirement: named style, palette values, type pairing and a rationale tying each to the stated design_intent
tests_required: the direction cites the design_intent it serves; a direction with no stated intent cannot be verified later
a pass entered at entry_gate 2 or higher must LOAD a previously recorded direction rather than proceeding without one
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the verifier, cross-examining whether the direction is falsifiable
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7702 emitted only when a direction with style, palette, type pairing and rationale is on disk; otherwise FAILED:UX-7702 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a narrower scope: one surface rather than the app
work_unit.mechanism: explicit recorded direction that converts G7 from taste into measurement

stages.title: G2 TRANSPOSE - mirror the current code onto the canvas (delegated)
G3 CRITIQUE - the two-track audit and rubric verdict (delegated)
G4 ITERATE - improve the composite until it stops moving

body.title: Propose and preview one candidate change without touching source

work_unit.title: Propose one candidate change and preview it as an injected style overlay
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce one candidate delta against the recorded direction and preview it as an ephemeral overlay, so a candidate can be rejected before any source file is edited.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: candidate generation is design judgement; the overlay mechanics are mechanical

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the candidate's CSS/token delta, the rubric dimension it targets, and the predicted composite movement
tests_required: a candidate is previewed as an overlay and leaves app source byte-identical
a candidate that targets no rubric dimension is rejected as untestable
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the verifier, who scores the candidate before it is allowed to become an edit
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7703 emitted only when at least one candidate with a targeted dimension and a predicted movement exists; otherwise FAILED:UX-7703 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: enumerate at least two structurally different candidates before a third attempt at the same one
work_unit.mechanism: overlay-previewed candidate generation with a targeted rubric dimension

stages.title: Source writes are opt-in - the implement gate refuses by default
G5 IMPLEMENT - the ONLY stage permitted to write app source

work_unit.title: Apply the accepted candidate to app source as one scoped change
work_unit.question_or_target: Turn the accepted overlay delta into a single scoped source edit, recording the file:line touched so the revert gate can undo exactly this change and nothing else.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: mapping an overlay back to its source origin needs the codebase, not a diff

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every touched file:line with the before and after text, so the change is byte-reversible
tests_required: the recorded file:line set is sufficient to revert the change exactly
no file outside the declared write_paths is modified
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the verifier, who did not author the change and holds the revert veto
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7704 emitted only when the change is applied and every touched file:line is recorded with before/after text; otherwise FAILED:UX-7704 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: revert and propose a structurally different candidate rather than re-editing
work_unit.mechanism: single scoped source edit with a byte-reversible file:line record

stages.title: G6 DRIVE - exercise the change in the running app without editing source

work_unit.title: Drive the changed surfaces and capture the post-change evidence
work_unit.question_or_target: Interact with every surface the change touches and capture screenshots and snapshots, so the verifier judges the change as USED rather than as read.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: choosing which interactions exercise the change is judgement; the clicks are mechanical

work_unit.evidence_requirement: one post-change screenshot and snapshot per touched surface, captured with the SAME parameters as the G0 baseline
tests_required: capture parameters match the baseline's; a differently-sized capture is not a comparison
a surface the change touched but the driver could not reach is listed UNDRIVEN, never as passing
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7705 emitted only when every touched surface is either driven with captured evidence or listed UNDRIVEN; otherwise FAILED:UX-7705 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a different rail (accessibility reference, then CSS selector, then coordinates)
work_unit.mechanism: post-change driving with baseline-matched capture parameters

stages.title: G7 VERIFY - is the INTENDED delta present, with no regression

work_unit.title: Measure the delta against the G0 baseline and the G1 direction
work_unit.question_or_target: Compare the post-change evidence to the baseline and decide whether the delta the direction INTENDED is present and whether anything else regressed - the two questions the revert gate consumes.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a same-vendor verifier shares the implementer's blind spots, so the revert veto is cross-vendor

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per-metric before and after values from the baseline and post-change artifacts, plus an explicit intended-versus-observed comparison
tests_required: a change that WORSENS measured contrast is reported as a regression and triggers the revert gate
a change that improves the targeted dimension while worsening another is reported as a regression, not as a net win
both-states control: an unchanged app yields zero delta and zero regression, so the verifier is not manufacturing movement
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the primer, cross-examining whether the baseline used is the one it captured
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7706 emitted only when an intended-delta verdict and a regression count are both recorded with per-metric evidence; otherwise FAILED:UX-7706 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then escalate: a verifier that cannot decide twice is a measurement problem, not a design one
work_unit.mechanism: baseline-anchored intended-versus-observed delta with an independent regression count

stages.title: The revert-gate trigger - a failed post-check does not stay applied
Automatically revert a change that failed its own post-check

diagnose.title: Attribute the regression to a specific applied file:line

work_unit.title: Attribute the regression to the exact change that caused it
work_unit.question_or_target: Name which recorded file:line edit produced the regression, because reverting the whole pass when one edit is at fault discards work that was correct.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: attribution is the root-cause step the repair loop requires before it may act

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the specific file:line, the metric it moved, and the measurement that links the two
tests_required: a multi-edit change attributes the regression to a subset, not to all edits
an unattributable regression escalates rather than reverting everything by default
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the reverter, who refuses to act on an unattributed diagnosis
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7707 emitted only when a specific file:line subset is named, or the diagnosis is explicitly UNATTRIBUTED; otherwise FAILED:UX-7707 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then escalate to the owner rather than guessing at attribution
work_unit.mechanism: per-edit regression attribution before any revert is authorised

repair.title: Revert exactly the attributed edits and nothing else

work_unit.title: Restore the attributed file:line edits to their recorded before-text
work_unit.question_or_target: Revert only the attributed edits using the before-text recorded at G5, and prove byte-equality with the pre-change state for those regions.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the reverter is deliberately not the implementer, so the author does not certify its own undo

work_unit.evidence_requirement: a byte-level comparison of each reverted region against the recorded before-text
tests_required: the reverted regions are byte-identical to the recorded before-text
edits NOT named by the diagnosis remain applied, so a partial revert stays partial on purpose
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the verifier, which re-runs its own measurement after the revert
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-7708 emitted only when every attributed region is byte-restored and unattributed edits are untouched; otherwise FAILED:UX-7708 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then escalate: a failing revert is an irreversibility finding and must reach the owner
work_unit.mechanism: attributed-subset byte-restore performed by a role other than the author

verify.title: Independently confirm the regression is gone after the revert

stages.title: No gate may silently depend on a gate the router skipped
The shared completion predicate over the whole pass

impact.blast_radius: edits app source under the declared write paths at G5 only; every edit is byte-reversible from the G5 record and the revert gate exercises that path

bp7.why_not_deterministic: G3 and G4 are model-judgement gates and G6 drives a live browser whose layout is not byte-stable; the journal is still recorded and divergence is reported semantically rather than claimed hash-equal.

worked_example.scenario: Reframe's export panel is cramped. Run the full loop with source writes authorised.

params.design_intent: increase export-panel breathing room without reducing contrast or tap-target size

expected_trace: g1-direct -> spacing scale 8pt, palette unchanged, rationale cites the intent
g2-transpose -> delegated to code-to-canvas-mirror-round-trip; propagate_failure false, so a Figma quota failure does not kill the pass
g3-critique -> delegated to two-track-ui-audit-rubric-verdict; composite 2.6/4 with a contrast critical error on one label
g4-iterate -> round 1 raises spacing and composite to 3.1; round 2 no progress; loop exits on no_progress_rounds
g5-authorisation PASS -> g5-implement edits 3 files, 5 lines, before-text recorded
g6-drive -> all 7 surfaces driven with baseline-matched capture parameters
g7-verify -> intended spacing delta PRESENT, but contrast on the label REGRESSED from 4.7 to 3.9

g7-gate FAILS -> revert-gate: diagnose attributes the regression to 1 of the 5 lines; apply-revert byte-restores that line only; confirm-reverted re-measures contrast at 4.7 with the other 4 lines still applied
worked_example.expected_terminal_state: SUCCESS:UX-7708 (partial revert: 4 of 5 edits kept, 1 reverted)

bp7.unverified: UNVERIFIED gate-skip correctness - the router lets a caller enter at any gate, and nothing yet proves no gate silently depends on a skipped predecessor. The `router-coherence` gate exists to make that check explicit, but its predicate is asserted by the workflow rather than measured by this unit. Settling experiment = enter at each of the nine modes and confirm every entered gate finds its inputs on disk.

distinct_from.bp-ux-02: that is the AUDIT engine; this is the pipeline that calls it as G3 - the containment is a declared subworkflow, not a description
distinct_from.bp-ux-04: that is the canvas mirror; this calls it as G2
distinct_from.bp-ux-05: that acts before a UI exists; this acts on a running one
